comment: Boundary probes for Node runtime and package work versus language-only and browser-only neighbors.

queries.query: Fix this Node file-processing service so its streams respect backpressure and close descriptors after an upstream error.
Repair the package.json exports map so supported ESM consumers can load the public subpath without exposing internals.
Fix this Node spawn wrapper so abort terminates the owned process tree, drains both pipes, and returns only after close.
Implement a Node CLI command that streams a large NDJSON export into the import API in batches.
Use $nodejs-development to make this CLI handle signals, child-process failure, and exit codes correctly.
Update this TypeScript Node HTTP server so AbortSignal cancellation reaches the database adapter and shutdown drains requests.
Fix the JavaScript event handler in this browser-only widget; no server or package behavior changes.
Improve this TypeScript union and generic API; it is runtime-neutral and package metadata is unchanged.
Reduce the Docker image size for this service without changing its Node runtime or package configuration.
